_comment: Seeds and preprocessing protocol used for the reported experiments.

evaluation_split.train: all interactions except the final two

preprocessing.image_policy: filter items without a usable main image
offline_item_steps: caption at most one main image with CMSA
extract ordered descriptors and confidences with DCIM
embed enriched item text with Qwen3-Embedding-4B
encode the image with frozen CLIP ViT-L/14
fuse text and visual vectors before RQ-VAE quantization
assign three hierarchical RQ codes and an optional collision suffix
obtain one binary QARM label per descriptor before policy training
